mill
Use the old beams to cross the millpond.
Blue beams rise and fall with the water.
Keep moving across the cracked beams.

canopy

The first branch is ready to break.
Jump over the ripples. Watch for his golden cap.
cavern

ridge

Three blocks when fresh. Change gear with Esc.

Watch the thorns. Follow the pass down to the river.
